title: Trio inputs stay editable while saving=True; success response deletes the entry and silently discards keystrokes typed during the in-flight save
evidence:
reference_panel.gleam text_input body (no disabled attribute on the input):
    html.input([
      attribute("data-testid", testid),
      attribute("type", "text"),
      attribute("value", value),
      attribute("aria-label", label),
      event.on_input(msg.UserEditedRefcheckTrio(call_id, field, _)),

disabled_attr applies only to the save button:
  let disabled_attr = case saving {
    True -> [attribute("disabled", "true")]
...
            attribute("data-testid", "refcheck-edit-save-" <> slot),
...
            disabled_attr,

client.gleam ApiReturnedRefcheckAction Ok arm:
              let edit_kept = dict.delete(model.refcheck_edit, call_id)
detail: Keystrokes landing between save-click and the success response write the call-id-keyed dict correctly, but the Ok handler unconditionally deletes the entry — those edits vanish silently under a success toast (#611's harm class, narrower window).
recommended_fix: Apply the same disabled_attr (saving=True) to the three trio inputs via text_input, matching the save button, so no edit can race the in-flight save.

title: Reordered-refetch → save composed sequence is not pinned: substitute test stops at render, save test has no refetch
evidence:
Test 2's final assertions end at the re-render, with no save click:
  simulate.view(sim)
  |> element.to_string
  |> string.contains("value=\"new.referee@example.ie\"")
  |> should.be_true
}

Test 1 saves with no intervening refetch:
  let sim =
    simulate.click(
      sim,
      on: query.element(matching: query.attribute(
        "data-testid",
        "refcheck-edit-save-landlord_ref",
      )),
    )
detail: Round guard requires typed-value-survives-reorder → save-persists-NEW-value end-to-end; each half is pinned separately but the composed stale-save sequence (refetch lands between typing and save) has no biting test.
recommended_fix: In test 2, after the refetch-survival assertions, click refcheck-edit-save-landlord_ref and assert saving:True with the typed email retained in the dict entry.
